overview: Weight & Balance is a first-person ballast-themed interaction fixture. Despite the equilibrium theme, the current rules implement a fixed left-pan, right-pan, gate sequence rather than adjustable masses or simulated weighing. The objective is to complete those three station interactions in order.
rules: Place the left ballast first; it then disables.
The right ballast only registers after the left, and cannot be counted twice.
Loading the right pan after the left enables the counterweight gate.
Interact with the gate after both loads to complete the game.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The documented setting is a mechanical ballast puzzle, with no narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
